title: 限制 Team View 轮询的模型调用记录读取开销
constraints: Read-side only; do not rewrite durable delivery facts
Do not share freshness cache across snapshots
Run only incremental Team View tests

verification.good: Each sidecar route ledger is decoded once per snapshot and all views retain the same typed runs.
verification.base: Missing or empty route ledgers still render an empty runs list.
verification.bad: Polling repeatedly decodes every run for every view or hides newly published/corrupt facts.

rollback: Revert the platform commit and restart ase-console; preserve all sidecar facts.
